schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proof_set (
  slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (slot = 1),
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  pounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 40,
  reps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8 CHECK (reps >= 0),
  completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (completed IN (0, 1)),
  completion_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (completion_attempts >= 0)
)

schemaV2: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proof_session_v2 (slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(slot = 1), session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, active_rest_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proof_sets_v2 (session_id TEXT NOT NULL, set_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 3), planned_pounds INTEGER NOT NULL, planned_reps INTEGER NOT NULL, pounds INTEGER NOT NULL, reps INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reps >= 0), completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(completed IN (0,1)), completion_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(session_id, set_id), UNIQUE(session_id, ordinal))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proof_rests_v2 (session_id TEXT NOT NULL, rest_id TEXT NOT NULL, set_id TEXT NOT NULL, deadline REAL NOT NULL, skipped_at REAL, PRIMARY KEY(session_id, rest_id), UNIQUE(session_id, set_id))
importLegacy: INSERT INTO proof_session_v2 (slot, session_id, active_rest_id) SELECT 1, session_id, CASE WHEN rest_deadline IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE set_id || ':rest' END FROM proof_set WHERE slot = 1

WITH fixture(ordinal, pounds, reps) AS (VALUES (1, 40, 8), (2, 50, 8), (3, 45, 10)) INSERT INTO proof_sets_v2 (session_id,set_id,ordinal,planned_pounds,planned_reps,pounds,reps,completed,completion_attempts) SELECT legacy.session_id, CASE WHEN f.ordinal = 1 THEN legacy.set_id ELSE legacy.set_id || ':planned:' || f.ordinal END, f.ordinal,f.pounds,f.reps,CASE WHEN f.ordinal = 1 THEN legacy.pounds ELSE f.pounds END, CASE WHEN f.ordinal = 1 THEN legacy.reps ELSE f.reps END, CASE WHEN f.ordinal = 1 THEN legacy.completed ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN f.ordinal = 1 THEN legacy.completion_attempts ELSE 0 END FROM proof_set legacy CROSS JOIN fixture f WHERE legacy.slot = 1

INSERT INTO proof_rests_v2 (session_id,rest_id,set_id,deadline,skipped_at) SELECT session_id,set_id || ':rest',set_id,rest_deadline,rest_skipped_at FROM proof_set WHERE slot = 1 AND rest_deadline IS NOT NULL
